camel_example: aliyun vs DescribeVsDomainReqBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2021-10-16T07:00:46Z' --DomainName 'example.aliyundoc.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2022-01-15T16:00:00Z' --Interval 300 --version 2018-12-12 --method POST --force
description_en: Query network request monitoring data for a domain name
description_zh: 获取域名网络请求监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun vs describe-vs-domain-req-bps-data --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --start-time 2022-01-15T16:00:00Z --end-time 2021-10-16T07:00:46Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVsDomainReqBpsData

parameters.help_en: Visual Edge Computing Service domain name
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Start time of the data query. Use ISO 8601 notation and UTC time.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
Minimum data granularity is 5 minutes.
If you omit this parameter, the system reads data from the last 24 hours by default.
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
最小数据粒度为5分钟
不写默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
End time must be later than start time. Use ISO 8601 notation and UTC time.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间需大于起始时间；获日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Time granularity for the query, in seconds. Valid values: 300, 3600, and 86400. If you omit this parameter or specify an unsupported value, the default value 300 is used
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的时间粒度，支持300, 3600和86400秒。不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: ISP name in English. Get this value from the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp operation. If you omit this parameter, the system queries data for all ISPs
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名。通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得，不传该参数代表查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: Region name in English. Get this value from the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp operation. If you omit this parameter, the system queries data for all regions
parameters.help_zh: 区域英文名。通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得，不传该参数代表查询所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: Time interval between records, in seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位

DomainName.description_en: The domain name of the Visual Edge Computing Service

TimeStamp.description_en: Start time of the time slice
